roleValueStreams.subStream: Collections Management — Delinquency monitoring and dunning
roleValueStreams.inputs: Aging data, missed payments, broker/customer outreach history, dispute flags
roleValueStreams.outputs: Dunning notices, payment arrangements, escalations, write-off recommendations
roleValueStreams.upstream: Open receivables, customer account status, credit policies
roleValueStreams.downstream: Customer service, finance control, bad debt review, producer/account management
roleValueStreams.notes: Aligned to current L2 stream with more process-level specificity.

roleValueStreams.subStream: Payment Processing — Cash application and suspense resolution
roleValueStreams.inputs: Bank files, lockbox feeds, payment confirmations, unapplied cash items
roleValueStreams.outputs: Applied cash, cleared suspense items, updated account balances, payment status
roleValueStreams.upstream: Treasury banking feeds, payment channels, customer remittances
roleValueStreams.downstream: Collections follow-up, customer service, ledger reconciliation
roleValueStreams.notes: Aligned to current L2 stream with more process-level specificity.

roleValueStreams.subStream: Resolution & Recovery — Settlement, payment and subrogation handling
roleValueStreams.inputs: Approved settlement terms, payment instructions, salvage/subrogation opportunities
roleValueStreams.outputs: Settlement letters, payment approvals, closed claim, recovery actions
roleValueStreams.upstream: Investigation outcome, authority approvals, finance/payment controls
roleValueStreams.downstream: Customer service, finance, reinsurance recoveries, litigation management
roleValueStreams.notes: Aligned to current L2 stream with more process-level specificity.

roleValueStreams.subStream: Investigation & Evaluation — Liability, damage and reserve assessment
roleValueStreams.inputs: Evidence, estimates, medical/legal documents, vendor reports, fraud indicators
roleValueStreams.outputs: Updated reserves, liability view, action plan, negotiation posture
roleValueStreams.upstream: Coverage decision, experts, SIU/legal input, repair or medical networks
roleValueStreams.downstream: Settlement approval, recoveries, finance and reinsurance notifications
roleValueStreams.notes: Aligned to current L2 stream with more process-level specificity.

roleValueStreams.subStream: Coverage & Assignment — Coverage validation and workflow routing
roleValueStreams.inputs: Policy wording, coverage limits, endorsements, claim facts
roleValueStreams.outputs: Coverage position, assigned adjuster, investigation plan, reserve trigger
roleValueStreams.upstream: FNOL intake, policy administration, prior claims history
roleValueStreams.downstream: Investigation, reserve setup, legal review where needed
roleValueStreams.notes: Aligned to current L2 stream with more process-level specificity.

roleValueStreams.subStream: Claim Intake — FNOL capture and triage
roleValueStreams.inputs: Loss notice, policy details, insured contact data, incident facts
roleValueStreams.outputs: Claim record, triage decision, assignment, initial severity view
roleValueStreams.upstream: Customers, brokers, TPAs, policy administration
roleValueStreams.downstream: Claims investigation, reserving, customer updates
roleValueStreams.notes: Aligned to current L2 stream with more process-level specificity.

roleValueStreams.subStream: Authority Design — Delegated authority terms and control design
roleValueStreams.inputs: Underwriting appetite, authority limits, product rules, reporting requirements
